activity.notes: Söyembikä governed the Kazan Khanate as regent for her young son after Safa Giray's death. ATLAS records the historical regency and does not use later tower-suicide legends as chronological evidence.

sources.title: Süyümbike and the Kazan Khanate — Çukurova University Turkology Research Center
sources.citation_text: The study discusses Söyembikä/Süyümbike as the ruling regent of the Kazan Khanate after Safa Giray's death.

sources.title: Süyümbike and her image in historical memory
sources.citation_text: The study describes Süyümbike as ruler/regent of Kazan in 1549–1551.
